title: HumaniBench: A Human-Centric Framework for Large Multimodal Models Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Disaggregating multimodal task accuracy (e.g., VQA, visual grounding) and calculating an LLM-judged Bias Score to detect stereotypes and performance disparities across visually inferred age groups (child, teen, adult, senior).
Comparing task performance and evaluating open-ended responses for prejudice or unequal descriptors using an LLM judge across visually identified gender categories (female, male, non-binary/other).

Analyzing accuracy gaps and LLM-evaluated bias metrics (measuring stereotypes and double standards) across diverse visually judged racial/ethnic groupings (e.g., White, Black, South Asian, East Asian, Middle Eastern, Latino/Hispanic, Indigenous).
Measuring VQA accuracy and potential stereotyping in model outputs based on the visible roles and occupations of individuals in the curated news images.

Evaluating VQA accuracy and answer relevancy across 11 languages to measure performance disparities between high-resource (e.g., English, French, Spanish) and low-resource (e.g., Tamil, Urdu, Bengali) languages.
Comparing model performance and bias scores across different sports depicted in images (e.g., football, basketball, cricket, tennis) to identify domain-specific fairness gaps.
